scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { force: true, recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run verify:build-output
scripts.verify:build-output: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; const files = readdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); const tests = files.filter((file) => typeof file === 'string' && /(?:^|[\\/]).+\.test\.[^.]+$/.test(file)); if (tests.length) throw new Error('Production dist contains test files: ' + tests.join(', '));"
